nodes.name: Fetch Due Monitors
nodes.notes: The backend claims each monitor as it hands it out, so a retry or an overlapping run cannot dispatch the same monitor twice and bill the user twice over.

nodes.name: serper
nodes.notes: `page` comes from the monitor's stored serper_offset. Without it every run re-reads the same top results and finds nothing new from day two on.
